title: THE UPI DOUBLE-CHARGE INCIDENT

scene_1.speaker: ROHIT
scene_1.dialogue: Priya! Production is double-charging users on UPI retries! Look at Postman, status 200!

scene_3.speaker: PRIYA
scene_3.dialogue: Status 200 on a single request means nothing! If the client retries on timeout without an Idempotency Key, the gateway charges twice.

takeaway:
💡 QA TAKEAWAY:
Never test APIs with status 200 alone. Always validate Idempotency-Key headers and network retry storms.
author: World Test Organisation
